# Damage

**Category:** Exploit  
**Aliases:** Damage

## What it does

Damage is an exploit module that makes you take fall-style damage to yourself on demand, without anything in the world actually hurting you. When you enable it, it sends a burst of movement packets that trick the server into thinking you fell, so the server applies damage to your character. The module fires once each time you turn it on and then leaves itself off, so flip it on again whenever you want another hit.

Description basis: [publisher description](https://liquidbounce.net/docs/modules/exploit/damage). The module's behavior on a stock Minecraft 26.3 server has not been verified unless separately documented in [research](../../RESEARCH.md).
